recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the work group later wants a direct cross-link to a specific extension-pack display extension, handle that as a new editorial/discoverability request rather than as a required FHIR-25949 correction.
issue_request: FHIR-25949 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested explicit clarification that QuestionnaireResponses do not contain unanswered items, with answer.value[x] required, a rule that question items are included only with at least one answer, no broad invariant requiring answer or child items because display items can have neither, and guidance allowing display items to be included in completed responses when needed.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git fe2213975a3205546ea589efc902f9dfa2022d7e, referenced in the Jira comments. That commit updated source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml and source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml to require QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x], define QuestionnaireResponse.item around items for which answers are provided, and add validation guidance for incomplete versus completed/amended responses.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Later current-source changes for FHIR-37550 and FHIR-38853 adjusted the same QuestionnaireResponse notes and nesting text but did not reverse the FHIR-25949 unanswered-item rule. The linked 2020 Zulip thread and FHIR SDC minutes support the Jira disposition, and a related Jira search found no separate final issue requiring a different current-source change. The relevant display-category extension source is now in the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, so there is no missing core extension definition to edit for this issue.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active StructureDefinition and notes already carry the required behavior: answers have mandatory values, completed/amended QuestionnaireResponses remove non-answered question items, incomplete responses may temporarily contain non-answered/non-enabled data, and display items may be retained when interpretation requires them.

related_jiras.note: Later published work updated QuestionnaireResponse notes around the required questionnaire element and resolvable Questionnaire scope without changing the unanswered-item/completed-response rule.
